headline: Early reference: latest official benchmarks with effective dates. Nigeria parallel-market observations are not included in this edition (insufficient verified sources).
nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks, dated 19 Nov. Nigeria parallel-market observations are not shown in this Early Look: fewer than two independent current observations could be verified.

Ghana.note: Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates, 19 Nov (latest dated table).

Kenya.note: CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates, 19 Nov (latest dated table); not a standalone buy or sell quote.

South Africa.note: SARB weighted-average bank rates, 18 Nov. Carried forward: the 19 Nov SARB endpoint could not be retrieved. Latest verified value shown with its actual effective date.

Egypt.note: CBE official buy/sell mid-rates, 19 Nov; midpoints recomputed from buy/sell.

markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates (19 Nov); Kenya CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates (19 Nov; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates (18 Nov, carried forward — 19 Nov not retrievable); Egypt CBE official buy/sell mid-rates (19 Nov).
method: Official benchmark rates only; no Nigeria parallel premium computed this edition.
official_sources: Central Bank of Nigeria and national official reference tables
